verses.pali: Saṁyutta Nikāya 48.58
verses.english: Linked Discourses 48.58

verses.pali: 6. Sūkarakhatavagga
verses.english: 6. The Boar’s Cave

verses.pali: Sūkarakhatasutta
verses.english: The Boar’s Cave

verses.pali: Ekaṁ samayaṁ bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate sūkarakhatāyaṁ.
verses.english: At one time the Buddha was staying near Rājagaha, on the Vulture’s Peak Mountain in the Boar’s Cave.

verses.pali: Tatra kho bhagavā āyasmantaṁ sāriputtaṁ āmantesi:
verses.english: Then the Buddha said to Venerable Sāriputta:

verses.pali: “kiṁ nu kho, sāriputta, atthavasaṁ sampassamāno khīṇāsavo bhikkhu tathāgate vā tathāgatasāsane vā paramanipaccakāraṁ pavattamāno pavattatī”ti?
verses.english: “Sāriputta, considering what benefit does a mendicant with defilements ended, in rolling forth, roll forth with utmost deference for the Realized One or his instructions?”

verses.pali: “Anuttarañhi, bhante, yogakkhemaṁ sampassamāno khīṇāsavo bhikkhu tathāgate vā tathāgatasāsane vā paramanipaccakāraṁ pavattamāno pavattatī”ti.
verses.english: “Sir, it is considering the supreme sanctuary from the yoke that a mendicant with defilements ended, in rolling forth, rolls forth with utmost deference for the Realized One or his instructions.”

verses.pali: “Sādhu sādhu, sāriputta.
verses.english: “Good, good, Sāriputta!

verses.pali: Anuttarañhi, sāriputta, yogakkhemaṁ sampassamāno khīṇāsavo bhikkhu tathāgate vā tathāgatasāsane vā paramanipaccakāraṁ pavattamāno pavattati.
verses.english: For it is considering the supreme sanctuary from the yoke that a mendicant whose defilements are ended, in rolling forth, rolls forth with utmost deference for the Realized One or his instructions.

verses.pali: Katamo ca, sāriputta, anuttaro yogakkhemo yaṁ sampassamāno khīṇāsavo bhikkhu tathāgate vā tathāgatasāsane vā paramanipaccakāraṁ pavattamāno pavattatī”ti?
verses.english: And what is that supreme sanctuary from the yoke?”

verses.pali: “Idha, bhante, khīṇāsavo bhikkhu saddhindriyaṁ bhāveti upasamagāmiṁ sambodhagāmiṁ,
verses.english: “It’s when a mendicant with defilements ended develops the faculties of faith,

verses.pali: vīriyindriyaṁ bhāveti …pe…
verses.english: energy,

verses.pali: satindriyaṁ bhāveti …
verses.english: mindfulness,

verses.pali: samādhindriyaṁ bhāveti …
verses.english: immersion,

verses.pali: paññindriyaṁ bhāveti upasamagāmiṁ sambodhagāmiṁ.
verses.english: and wisdom, which lead to peace and awakening.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ kho, bhante, anuttaro yogakkhemo yaṁ sampassamāno khīṇāsavo bhikkhu tathāgate vā tathāgatasāsane vā paramanipaccakāraṁ pavattamāno pavattatī”ti.
verses.english: It is considering this supreme sanctuary from the yoke that a mendicant with defilements ended, in rolling forth, rolls forth with utmost deference for the Realized One or his instructions.”

verses.pali: “Sādhu sādhu, sāriputta.
verses.english: “Good, good, Sāriputta!

verses.pali: Eso hi, sāriputta, anuttaro yogakkhemo yaṁ sampassamāno khīṇāsavo bhikkhu tathāgate vā tathāgatasāsane vā paramanipaccakāraṁ pavattamāno pavattatīti.
verses.english: For this is that supreme sanctuary from the yoke.

verses.pali: Katamo ca, sāriputta, paramanipaccakāro yaṁ khīṇāsavo bhikkhu tathāgate vā tathāgatasāsane vā paramanipaccakāraṁ pavattamāno pavattatī”ti?
verses.english: And what is that utmost deference that a mendicant with defilements ended, in rolling forth, shows towards the Realized One or his instructions?”

verses.pali: “Idha, bhante, khīṇāsavo bhikkhu satthari sagāravo viharati sappatisso, dhamme sagāravo viharati sappatisso, saṅghe sagāravo viharati sappatisso, sikkhāya sagāravo viharati sappatisso, samādhismiṁ sagāravo viharati sappatisso.
verses.english: “It’s when a mendicant with defilements ended maintains respect and reverence for the Teacher, the teaching, the Saṅgha, the training, and immersion.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ kho, bhante, paramanipaccakāro yaṁ khīṇāsavo bhikkhu tathāgate vā tathāgatasāsane vā paramanipaccakāraṁ pavattamāno pavattatī”ti.
verses.english: This is that utmost deference.”

verses.pali: “Sādhu sādhu, sāriputta.
verses.english: “Good, good, Sāriputta!

verses.pali: Eso hi, sāriputta, paramanipaccakāro yaṁ khīṇāsavo bhikkhu tathāgate vā tathāgatasāsane vā paramanipaccakāraṁ pavattamāno pavattatī”ti.
verses.english: For this is that utmost deference that a mendicant with defilements ended, in rolling forth, shows towards the Realized One or his instructions.”

verses.pali: Aṭṭhamaṁ.
